usual_baseline: Full BOAST compliance 8.8% [1375]. Antibiotics within 1 hour: 13.3% [1274], 27% [1620], 41.7% [1601]. High-energy debridement within 12 hours 25% [1681] and 41.7% [1601]. Soft tissue cover within 72 hours 56.4% [1545]. Joint orthoplastic consultants at debridement 10% [1224] to 33.3% [1545]. Tetanus prophylaxis 48.8% [1274].
fix_that_works: A second weekly orthoplastics list halved missed 7-day soft tissue cover from 11% to 5% [1224]. Teaching, posters and a clerking proforma raised STAT antibiotic prescriptions from 15.4% to 51.7% and cut mean time from 271 to 233 minutes [1200]. Tracking antibiotic times with quarterly audits improved 1-hour order and administration [1597]. Soft tissue cover within 5 days rose from 50% to 100% [1407].
fix_that_fails: Education alone did not improve antibiotic timing [1597]. Mean time to antibiotics was still 233 minutes after improvement [1200]. Both consultants at initial debridement only reached 26% [1224].
consultant_advice: Antibiotic timing matters: prehospital antibiotics within 1 hour were linked to lower infection [1681]. Audit time from injury to antibiotic and STAT prescribing, or joint orthoplastic debridement. Link process to infection rates, which were 13–24% [1681][1375].
